title: Sliding window: shortest subarray with a large enough sum
summary: Grow the window on the right; while its sum is big enough, record it and shrink it from the left.

narration.text: best = {best} means no window has reached the target yet.
The window is empty, so its sum is {total}.
The window's left end starts at position {left}.
Grow the window: its right end moves to position {right}.
The right end has passed the last value.
Add {nums[right]}: the window sum is now {total}.
{total} ≥ {target}: this window is big enough. Record it, then try shrinking it.
This is the first window to reach the target.
Length {right - left + 1} beats the best so far, {best}.
Length {right - left + 1} doesn't beat the best so far, {best}.
The shortest window found so far has length {best}.
Drop {nums[left]} from the left end: the sum falls to {total}.
The window now starts at position {left}.
No window reaches {target}, so the answer is {best}.
The shortest window with a sum of at least {target} has length {best}.
